description: This file defines the DataValidator class, which handles validation logic for cell values in a spreadsheet, including type-specific validation and list validation.

classes.name: DataValidator
classes.description: Provides methods to validate cell data based on data validation rules.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a cell contains a valid value according to its data validation rules.

methods.name: numericOperator
methods.description: Performs comparison operations between a cell value and validation formulas based on the operator.

methods.name: isValueInList
methods.description: Checks if a cell's value exists within a specified list, either inline or from a cell range.
